A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Auto-Connect and contain complete, readable main text and appendices A–C. Text comparison and visual inspection support reliable comparison of their equations, tables and figures.

before.justification: v1 reports original rigging, skinning and ablation results on Art-XL2.0 and ModelsResource in Section 4 and Appendix B, including quantitative tables and qualitative examples.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results in Section 4 and Appendix B. Results retained from v1 remain original outcomes of this work.

M1.justification: Section 3.2, Equation (7), adds log-sigmoid around the policy/reference log-ratio difference before multiplying by the reward difference. This is a limited correction to the specified DPO training loss. The PDFs do not establish an implementation change or retraining.

E1.justification: Both versions use Art-XL2.0 and ModelsResource for rigging and skinning, with the same image-generated meshes, unseen-pose examples and snake-like failure cases. No dataset, task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout the comparisons. Rigging retains RigNet, Magic-hier, Magic-spatial and UniRig; skinning retains RigNet, NeuroSkinning and HeterSkinNet with and without the proposed module. Table 3 retains the same tokenization comparators.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1–4.2 and Appendix A.2 retain the same splits, metrics, augmentation, model sizes, batch sizes and training budgets, including five post-training epochs on 14k preference pairs. No separate evaluation-protocol revision is reported.

E4.justification: The tokenization, DPO and data-augmentation analyses in Section 4.4 remain unchanged. Appendix B.3 retains the same additional DPO ablation, and the generalization examples and Appendix C failure cases are also preserved.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests for the empirical comparisons. Uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–6 retain identical numerical entries, and the qualitative result images and findings are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains the proposed method's Art-XL2.0 IoU of 82.806%, and Appendix Table 6 retains its ModelsResource IoU of 73.108%.

T1.justification: Equation (7) changes mathematically through insertion of log-sigmoid: the reward-weighted linear log-ratio margin becomes a reward-weighted log-sigmoid objective. This is a substantive but localized formula correction. The remaining definitions and equations are unchanged, with no added proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and performance claims concerning connectivity-preserving tokenization, RigFormer, reward-guided DPO and geodesic-aware bone selection. Their scientific scope is unchanged.

C2.justification: The explanations of topology improvements, baseline failure mechanisms and skinning benefits are retained. Appendix C preserves the limitation on snake-like inputs, its attribution to missing training examples, and the same proposed future directions.

D1.justification: Implementation and access information remains unchanged, including Appendix A's architecture, optimizer settings, learning rates, smoothing iterations, hardware and training times. The project link and baseline code/weight availability statements are also retained.

R1.justification: Section 2 and all 74 numbered references are unchanged in substance. The positioning relative to prior rigging, autoregressive generation and preference-optimization work, including the claimed first application of DPO to rigging, is retained.

P1.justification: v2 removes the equal-contribution footnote and changes corresponding-author markers from daggers to asterisks. The substantive prose, terminology and section/appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The shortened author note allows the introductory paragraph to finish on page 1, producing limited reflow on pages 1–2. Equation (7)'s expanded expression moves its equation number below the line. Figures and tables retain their content, captions and organization.

improvement.justification: Adding log-sigmoid in Equation (7) corrects the printed reward-guided DPO objective, improving mathematical accuracy and the specification available to implementers. This is a useful, localized gain; empirical evidence and scientific claims remain unchanged, while the other edits concern author notes and layout.
